summary.text: Ryan Bivens is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 24 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer, he earned a bachelor's degree in agriculture from the University of Kentucky.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Bivens earned a bachelor's degree in agriculture from the University of Kentucky in 2001, and his career experience includes working as a farmer.
He took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2025, as the successor to Courtney Gilbert.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Agriculture, Elections, Constitutional Amendments and Intergovernmental Affairs, and House Transportation committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, and faces Democrat Johnny Pennington in the general election.
